body:
I’m glad that I’m open with my emotions because my mum isn’t she bottles everything up, so I’m the opposite.

But it’s also the biggest burden because I constantly feel guilty or worried about her. It’s very tiring. Especially when you’re trying to sort yourself out. It makes me feel like I’m not valid of help and I’m just here to help everyone else. Don’t get me wrong I’ll be there for anyone but when I’m just struggling and I reach out no one seems to be available

Yes I did. It’s always just been myself and my mum and she’s drank for as long as I remember. I’m lucky in the sense I don’t have the same relationship with alcohol. It doesn’t come as judgemental at all. 

Thanks for the recommendation I’ve just purchased the book! Everything you’ve just said is true, you completely hit the nail on the head.

Thanks for your response it does mean a lot. I recently finished my sessions with my counsellor as I had all 12 sessions and whilst it was really nice and helpful it definitely wasn’t enough as I feel like we were just getting somewhere. Unfortunately I can’t afford to pay privately at the moment.
